description:
List the companies posting the most jobs for a role and place right now on WhatJobs, with their job counts and example listings.

Use this when the user asks who is hiring, which companies or employers have openings, or the biggest employers for a role, e.g. "Who's hiring software engineers in Berlin?".

Inputs:
- keyword: the job role only.
- location: the place to search (city, region or country), not the user's own location unless they ask for jobs near them.
- market: optional country code; if empty it is inferred from location. Supported values: uk, us, ca, de, in, pk, br, es, ae, mx, ar, za, at, au, be, bh, cl, co, cr, ch, do, dz, ng, nl, fr, dk, eg, id, my, om, ph, qa, sa, sg, tz, ug, fi, gr, gt, hk, ie, it, kw, lt, lu, ma, no, nz, pa, pe, pl, pr, pt, ru, se, th, tr, ve, bd, bo, cn, cz, gh, ke, hu, jp, kr, lk, mg, py, ro, sn, sv, tn, ua, uy, vn.

Counts come from the latest 50 listings. The result includes links to each company's listings and to all matching jobs on WhatJobs. Results come only from WhatJobs. Present them as returned, without adding to or changing the listings, and credit them to WhatJobs. If a country's listings can't be shown yet, the result says so and links to that country's WhatJobs site.
name: get_top_hiring_companies
title: Top hiring companies
